summary: Strengthen cash, account and transaction controls with practical banking operations exercises. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Training in banking operations develops practical routines for accurate cash handling, account servicing and transaction control. For staff who process, supervise or report on routine bank services, it builds skills in cash proof and balancing, ledger and suspense-account reconciliation, maker-checker evidence, and classifying and escalating transaction exceptions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who process, supervise or report on routine bank services and need to strengthen day-to-day control evidence.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with banking products and routine transaction records is helpful. No coding is required.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
